# platform-orchestrator_resource_type_version (Resource)

Publishes one exact immutable Resource Type interface. Version 1 belongs to the resource_type catalogue identity; new publications start at 2 and must be consecutive. Existing Module Versions keep their original contracts. Destroy forgets this state reference and never deletes an interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_resource_type" "storage" {
  id            = "storage"
  output_schema = jsonencode({ type = "object" })
}

resource "platform-orchestrator_resource_type_version" "storage_v2" {
  resource_type_id          = platform-orchestrator_resource_type.storage.id
  version                   = 2
  expected_resource_version = 1 # The reviewed catalogue revision, not a live value that changes after publication.
  reason                    = "Add an endpoint to the storage interface"
  output_schema = jsonencode({
    type       = "object"
    properties = { endpoint = { type = "string" } }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_resource_version` (Number) Reviewed catalogue concurrency revision used only when creating this publication. Updating this input on an existing interface does not republish it.
- `output_schema` (String)
- `reason` (String) Immutable recorded publication reason.
- `resource_type_id` (String)
- `version` (Number) Exact next interface number, at least 2. This is permanent identity, not a catalogue concurrency counter.

### Optional

- `module_contract` (String) Optional bounded Module declaration contract as JSON. Absence remains null.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Immutable interface UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_resource_type_version.storage_v2 storage/2
```
